text:
maya: Heads up — main CI turned red right after my deps bump (pkg:storage 2.4.1 -> 2.5.0). Seems to fail on smoke-e2e: queue starvation on stage-runner-3. Anyone around?

arjun: link to the failing job?

maya: https://ci.redwoodinference.internal/builds/98234 — job 98234. Quick log excerpt:

```
ERROR: timeout waiting for worker from pool stage-runner-3
2026-03-18T10:02:13Z queue length=0 active=0 waiting=12
Autoscaler cooldown active, won't create new nodes
```

ops-bot: [alert] pipeline: main#98234 failed (smoke-e2e) — responders: eng-infra on-call

sam: can we just rerun that job? sometimes it's transient.

maya: tried `rerun 98234 --from=smoke-e2e` twice, same failure.

lina: sounds like autoscaler cooldown + a hot spot on runner-3. We saw similar this morning when nodepool autoscaler hit rate limits.

arjun: @lina any chance we can drain some low-priority jobs off runner-3 and push to runner-5?

lina: yep, can nudge routing. Quick command to check pods: `kubectl get pods -n ci -o wide | grep stage-runner-3`

jen: I can reroute smoke-e2e to runner-5 and kick a rerun if you want me to.

sam: nice — that avoids bisect for now, and buys time to investigate autoscaler.

jen: doing `reroute --job=98234 --to=runner-5` now...

jen: done. Rerunning job: `rerun 98234 --from=smoke-e2e --target=runner-5`

ops-bot: [info] job 98234 rerun scheduled on runner-5 by jen

jen: ok it's running. watching logs...

maya: thanks — if runner-5 passes we can confirm it's infra rather than my deps. I'll open a revert if it looks like my bump actually regressed something.

arjun: commit for the deps bump is `a7b3c9f`. Could you drop a link to the PR here?

maya: https://github.com/redwoodinference/platform/pull/4712 — small version bump + lockfile.

lina: looking at cluster metrics, autoscaler hit cooldown because of 6 scaling events in 10m from another job. We should relax the cooldown or add a higher burst capacity for smoke-e2e on main.

sam: is there an owner for autoscaler config? @infra-team?

arjun: pinging infra-team channel separately.

ops-bot: [deploybot] autoscaler event: cooldown_entered at 2026-03-18T09:59:48Z (policy: default-rate-limit)

jen: job 98234 passed on runner-5 :tada: logs look clean.

maya: great — so transient infra. I'll hold off on a revert then. Opening an issue: https://github.com/redwoodinference/platform/issues/1987 to track autoscaler cooldown and runner hotspots.

lina: I'll follow up with a short config change to allow one burst for smoke-e2e on main until autoscaler fix. CC-ing ops.

arjun: if anyone needs a bisect later I can kick it, but not necessary now.

sam: thanks everyone. If the autoscaler fix needs emergency patch, @lina and @jen please coordinate.

maya: thanks all! :thumbsup:
